DESIGN DECISION, recorded because it deviates in letter from step-4's "returns the exact send(...) object unchanged": `hostile-harness.readRefusal` reads only `layer`/`reasonLayer`, and the daemon's ServiceRefused spells it `refusedBy` — so a raw return makes `assertRefusedWith` throw HostileHarnessMisuseError instead of asserting.
